extension.description: Home of the Roc builds: Roc Gold, Haunted, Night Route, Noir Raven and Sesh Lounge, in Powerhouse, Medium and Lite tiers.

extension.summary: Install Roc builds from Roc Repo
extension.description: Pick a build and a tier for this device. Every build opens a preview gallery of its screenshots first, with the install action at the top. The installer downloads the build and applies it, then offers a restart.

extension.summary: Every WWF/WWE pay-per-view in order, year by year
extension.description: Pick a year and scroll its pay-per-views in true date order. Selecting an event jumps you into the Wrestling section to play it.
